title: Emit story.published to Caducus
description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** `src/papyrus_content/publish_alerts.py` is the only place a publish announces. Add `PutEvents` beside the newsletter invoke.

**Build.**
Same rules and the same swallow-errors stance: only a real publish, after the page is live, never fails or slows a publish, no-op when the plugin is off. `eventId` from lineage, so dedupe holds. Known gaps in `docs/newsletter.md` still apply on purpose: a bulk import must not alert.

**Acceptance.**
`features_backend` scenario for each of: real publish, republish, projection failure then retry, plugin off.

**Related:** kanbus-b47fad
